|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/teyhow.html</ref>

[[Tey How]] is a great support character to use in any Dark Side deck that dreads putting anything space. She allows you to essentially "block" drains much like [[Harc Seff]] (from the Special Edition set) does at sites so you will not need to deal with it. The easiest thing to do is place [[Tey How]] aboard a battleship and then make sure that starship has plenty of support. With her at any parsec 6 system, such as [[Kashyyyk (Dark){{!}}Kashyyyk]] which is a great drain location, you will be able to stop drains anywhere from [[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] to [[Corulag (Dark){{!}}Corulag]]!

And since she is a Neimoidian, you will be able to grab her with The [[Phantom]] Menance. Should be no trouble at all to set up the combo.
